title: Bin El Ouidane reservoir on 8 Oct 2026
summary: On 8 Oct 2026 the radar shows a lake of 29.91 km2 inside the 10 km circle around Bin El Ouidane. This date carries two flags, so every number below should be read with lower confidence.

sections.heading: What the radar shows here
sections.text: Open water averages -16.45 dB in HH and -22.38 dB in HV, still the darkest type. The circle averages -6.3 dB in HH and -13.47 dB in HV. Built-up land reaches 0.1 dB in HH, a very bright echo even for walls.

sections.heading: Terrain types and what they mean
sections.text: Trees, shrub and rugged slopes, 61.4% of the circle, give HV of -12.05 dB from volume scattering in leaves and branches. Rough dry ground and fields, 24.0%, sit at -8.49 dB in HH. Built-up land, 1.8%, keeps the lowest HV:HH ratio, -14.12 dB, the double-bounce signature of walls.

sections.heading: Data quality notes
sections.text: Two flags apply. The lake water threshold moved more than 1.0 dB from the previous date, and backscatter over built-up land shifted more than 0.5 dB from its June-September median. Possible cause: a processing offset in this product. Possible cause: a wet surface after rain. Rain records and reprocessed files would tell them apart. The lake outline is approximate, with 8.9% of it on land in the optical photo.
